name: Node based checks

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - "main"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "**.js"
      - "**.ts"
      - "package.json"
      - "yarn.lock"
      - "eslint.config.js"
      - "knip.json"
      - "tsconfig.json"
      - "jest.config.js"
      - ".github/workflows/**"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  # Pushing new changes to a branch will cancel any in-progress CI runs
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Linting
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20.19.x"
          cache: yarn

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --prefer-offline

      - name: Node eslint
        run: yarn lint

      - name: Detect dead code
        run: yarn knip

      - name: Detect dead code in production
        run: yarn knip:production

  type-check:
    name: TypeScript Type Checking
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20.19.x"
          cache: yarn

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive --prefer-offline

      - name: TypeScript type check
        run: yarn type-check

      # We only download and run Actionlint if there is any difference in GitHub Action workflows
      # https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/blob/main/docs/usage.md#on-github-actions
      # Note: Only runs on pull_request events, not push events (where github.event.pull_request is null)
      - name: Check GitHub Action changes
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        id: check-workflows
        run: |
          git fetch origin ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          if git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.sha }} | grep -q '^.github/workflows'; then
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            if response=$(curl -sf https://api.github.com/repos/rhysd/actionlint/releases/latest); then
              actionlint_version=$(echo "$response" | jq -r .tag_name)
              if [ -z "$actionlint_version" ]; then
                echo "Failed to parse Actionlint version"
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "actionlint_version=\"$actionlint_version\"" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            fi
          fi
      - name: Setup Actionlint
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.check-workflows.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: cache-actionlint
        with:
          path: ./actionlint
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-actionlint-${{ steps.check-workflows.outputs.actionlint_version }}
      - name: Download Actionlint
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.check-workflows.outputs.changed == 'true' && steps.cache-actionlint.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: bash <(curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhysd/actionlint/main/scripts/download-actionlint.bash)
      - name: Lint GitHub Actions
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.check-workflows.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "::add-matcher::.github/actionlint-matcher.json"
          SHELLCHECK_OPTS="-S warning" ./actionlint -c

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
